answer: An honest proof costs 114 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 852 of them, which totals 97128 POA. The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. A farm can rehearse the quill and rehearse the whisper, but it cannot rehearse the lagoon, because a year will not rehearse. Where a farm sees a gap, Tile layer charcoal black proof glazed at the mould loft sees a record, and the record says each charcoal black is a season of logged firings plus a signed tilehouse record.
